title: UPS旺季日均件量：预计环比增25%，全年指引上调后能否兑现？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Staking with UPS as chairs rally after that guidance boost, let's get straight to remain BOSIC.
segments.zh: UPS股价在业绩指引上调后上涨，我们直击现场，有请Remain BOSIC。

segments.en: Host of the close, he joins us live from UPS headquarters in Atlanta with the CEO of UPS Carol Tomay for an exclusive interview.
segments.zh: 《收盘》节目主持人从亚特兰大UPS总部现场连线，独家专访UPS首席执行官Carol Tomay。

segments.en: Thank you, Scarlett. Yes, we are here with Carol. Tomay fresh off the UPS's most recent earnings report, a Q3 number that beat on several
segments.zh: 谢谢，Scarlett。是的，我们和Carol在一起。Tomay刚刚结束UPS最新财报发布，第三季度多项指标超预期

segments.en: metrics in guidance going higher for the full year.
segments.zh: 并上调了全年业绩指引。

segments.en: There are a lot of questions right now about the sustainability of the growth, the sustainability of the turnaround that you've orchestrated.
segments.zh: 现在有很多关于增长可持续性、以及你所推动的转型可持续性的问题。

segments.en: What assurances did you give investors today that 2027 looks even better than 2026?
segments.zh: 你今天向市场参与者提供了什么保证，让他们相信2027年比2026年更好？

segments.en: Well, we'll first welcome to our headquarters here in Atlanta, Georgia, we're delighted to have you here.
segments.zh: 首先欢迎来到我们亚特兰大总部，很高兴你能来。

segments.en: And I'm super proud of the UPS team because we did report solid results today, including a return to volume growth for our SMB and enterprise customers in the United States.
segments.zh: 我为UPS团队感到非常自豪，因为我们今天确实公布了稳健的业绩，包括美国中小企业和大企业客户业务量恢复增长。

segments.en: And that gave us confidence to lift the guidance for the full year.
segments.zh: 这给了我们信心上调全年业绩指引。

segments.en: In fact, we're heading into the busiest season of the year, which is the peak holiday season.
segments.zh: 事实上，我们正进入一年中最繁忙的时期，也就是假日旺季。

segments.en: And based on forecasts that we received from our customers, we expect our volume, our average daily volume to increase about 25% from the third quarter to the fourth quarter.
segments.zh: 根据客户提供的预测，我们预计第四季度的日均业务量将比第三季度增长约25%。

segments.en: So given the underlying strength of the business, we were delighted to raise both our revenue and our profit guidance for the year.
segments.zh: 鉴于业务的基本面强劲，我们很高兴上调了全年的营收和利润指引。
